from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import Descriptors, Lipinski

smiles = 'CC12CCC(=O)C=C1CCC3C2CCC4(C3CCC4=O)C'
mol = Chem.MolFromSmiles(smiles)
print("Formula:", Chem.rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(mol))
print("Num H Donors (Lipinski):", Lipinski.NumHDonors(mol))
print("Num H Donors (Descriptors):", Descriptors.NumHDonors(mol))
print("Num H Acceptors (Lipinski):", Lipinski.NumHAcceptors(mol))
